overview.description: Noble Foods (formerly Deans Foods Ltd) should win a prize for knowing the secrets of the egg. As one of the largest UK egg producers, the company oversees all aspects of the chicken/egg cycle. Laying hens live on 250 company-owned farms and eat feed from company-owned mills. Noble packs more than 60 million fresh shell eggs weekly for its major retail customers and produces value-added egg products for its industrial and foodservice accounts. Its retail egg brands include Big & Fresh, Church & Manor, Goldenlay, and Woodland. At the end of their laying careers, Noble's hens become poultry products at the company processing plant.

overview.description: Vesuvius is a global leader in metal flow engineering, providing a full range of engineering services and solutions to its customers worldwide, principally serving the steel and foundry industries.

How sweet it is. The Billington Food Group (better known as Billington's) offers a line of organic and unrefined brown cane sugars for use in baking and as a sweetener for coffee and tea. The types of sugar marketed by the UK company include caster, demerara, granulated, icing sugar, and muscovado, as well as dried molasses. It imports its sugar from Mauritius, which it then packs and distributes from its facility in Ipswich to both retail food and food-manufacturing customers. Billington's has been a a subsidiary of Associated British Foods since 2004.

Gail’s Harley Davidson in Grandview, Missouri, We’re more than a motorcycle dealership; we’re proud to be your local Harley paradise! We offer one of the largest inventories of  Harley-Davidson motorcycles,  parts, accessories,official Harley-Davidson merchandise and MotorClothes in the Midwest.
We also have a great service center and a helpful finance center. 
Our dealership family lives by a simple truth: Every Day is an Excuse to Have Fun! Gail,  owner and president, rebuilt this dealership to be more than just a place to buy Harleys. Her dream was a Harley-Davidson DESTINATION! A place where all bikers could come to have fun, meet new friends and check out the latest and greatest Harley bikes. Gail’s vision culminated in our present-day location: all 55,000 square feet and 10 acres of the biker bliss.

Kinnerton Confectionery is Britain’s largest independent manufacturer of chocolate and novelty confectionery specialising in character merchandising.

Operating across three manufacturing sites in the UK and one in Ireland, we offer the ability to make Novelty, Panned and Boxed Chocolates. We currently employ around 800 employees and strive to never stand still, so innovation is at the heart of what we do!
